title: Nongsa Digital Park opens in Batam
description: Singapore's and Indonesia's foreign ministers opened the first three buildings of Nongsa Digital Park, a private park for IT firms and digital talent.
actor: Governments of Singapore and Indonesia; Citramas Group
significance: Framed Batam as a 'digital bridge' to Singapore; the park later became the core of Batam's data centre cluster.

title: GR 71/2019 narrows data localisation
description: Government Regulation 71/2019 limited the onshore data rule to public-scope operators; private operators may host offshore if authorities can access data, while financial sector rules still apply.
significance: Opened the door to offshore hosting (including Singapore) but kept public-sector and financial data onshore, sustaining local demand.

title: Google opens Jakarta cloud region
description: Google Cloud's asia-southeast2 region went live in Jakarta with three zones, its 24th region worldwide.
significance: First hyperscale cloud region in Indonesia, setting the template of in-country cloud for a large, data-rule-conscious market.

title: Alibaba Cloud plans third Indonesian data centre
description: Alibaba Cloud said it would launch a third Indonesian data centre in early 2021, after facilities built in 2018 and 2019.
significance: Chinese cloud arrived early and scaled first, before the US big three had regions in Indonesia.

title: Microsoft announces first Indonesian datacenter region
description: Microsoft said it would build its first datacenter region in Indonesia under its Berdayakan Ekonomi Digital Indonesia initiative.
significance: Committed the third US hyperscaler; the region took four years to open.

title: Nongsa Digital Park becomes a special economic zone
description: President Jokowi signed PP 68/2021 making Nongsa Digital Park a 166.45ha SEZ for digital and tourism activity, including a commercial data centre area, with a Rp16tn investment target.
significance: SEZ incentives turned Batam's park into a hyperscale landing zone for Singapore-linked operators.

title: AWS launches Jakarta region with US$5bn plan
description: AWS launched its Asia Pacific (Jakarta) region and estimated US$5bn (IDR 71tn) of investment over 15 years, including construction and operations.
significance: Indonesia got an AWS region before Malaysia and Thailand, a sign of its market size and data rules.

title: NTT opens 15MW Jakarta 3 in Bekasi
description: NTT launched Jakarta 3, a 15.2MW hyperscale-ready facility in Bekasi scalable to 45MW.
significance: Marked the shift of wholesale capacity to the Bekasi and Cikarang industrial belt east of Jakarta.

title: Parliament passes Personal Data Protection law
description: Lawmakers passed the PDP law with fines up to 2% of annual revenue and an oversight body to be set up by the president.
significance: Gave Indonesia a GDPR-style regime that shapes where data can sit and flow.

title: Huawei Cloud launches Indonesia region
description: Huawei Cloud launched its Jakarta region and committed US$300m over five years to local cloud infrastructure.
significance: Gave Indonesia three Chinese hyperscale clouds (Alibaba, Tencent, Huawei) alongside the US three.

title: Telkom, Singtel and Medco break ground in Batam
description: Telkom's NeutraDC, Singtel and Medco Power signed and broke ground on a 51MW, three-phase campus on 8ha in Kabil, Batam.
significance: Indonesia's state telco and Singapore's telco jointly bet on Batam as Singapore overflow.

title: Princeton Digital announces 96MW Batam campus
description: PDG unveiled a 96MW, four-building campus in Nongsa Digital Park as the first project of its SG+ strategy (about US$1bn initial plan with Johor).
significance: Made Batam an explicit part of the Singapore market, with Singapore EDB and BP Batam officials present.

title: Singapore conditionally approves 2GW of Indonesian power imports
description: Singapore's EMA granted conditional approvals for five projects to export 2GW of low-carbon power from Indonesia and signed a new interconnection MoU.
significance: Riau Islands solar began to be planned for export to Singapore, competing for the same land and grid that Batam data centres need.

title: EdgeConneX opens Jakarta campus
description: EdgeConneX held the grand opening of its 120MW Greater Jakarta campus in Bekasi Regency, backed by US$403.8m of sustainability-linked financing.
significance: US wholesale operators joined the Bekasi build-out.

title: Microsoft pledges US$1.7bn for Indonesian cloud and AI
description: Microsoft committed US$1.7bn over four years for new cloud and AI infrastructure and AI skilling for 840,000 people.
significance: Largest Microsoft investment in Indonesia; kicked off the 2024 wave of US AI pledges in Southeast Asia.

title: Ransomware cripples national data centre
description: A Brain Cipher ransomware attack on the government's National Data Centre hit at least 210 institutions and disrupted immigration services; attackers demanded about US$8m.
significance: Exposed weak state data infrastructure and sharpened sovereignty and resilience arguments for onshore, well-run capacity.

title: BDx Indonesia completes phase 1 of Jatiluhur AI campus
description: BDx Indonesia, a JV of BDx, Indosat and Lintasarta, completed phase 1 of its CGK4 campus at Jatiluhur, scalable to 500MW and billed renewable-powered.
significance: Pushed capacity beyond Bekasi toward cheaper land and hydro-adjacent West Java.

title: Indosat-Nvidia Solo AI centre slated for 2025 groundbreaking
description: Indosat said its AI centre with Nvidia at Solo Technopark would break ground in 2025 and be usable by 2027; a reported US$200m figure was not confirmed.
significance: First Nvidia-branded AI hub plan in Indonesia, sited away from Jakarta.

title: Indonesia joins BRICS as full member
description: Brazil announced Indonesia's full BRICS membership, approved by consensus after Jakarta deferred entry until after its 2024 election.
significance: Context: Jakarta hedges between Washington and Beijing while courting both US and Chinese cloud money.

title: Tencent pledges US$500m more for Indonesian cloud
description: Tencent said it would invest US$500m in Indonesia by 2030, including a third data centre; GoTo signed five-year cloud deals with Tencent and Alibaba.
significance: Chinese cloud doubled down as Prabowo courted Chinese investment.

title: US AI Diffusion Rule puts Indonesia in Tier 2
description: The Biden-era rule (published 15 Jan) placed Indonesia in the middle tier, where access to advanced AI chips would be capped by compute and licence pathways.
significance: Threatened to cap GPU imports just as AI campus plans were forming; never took effect.

title: Danantara sovereign fund launched
description: Prabowo launched Danantara, expected to oversee over US$900bn of state assets, with a first US$20bn across 20-plus projects including AI.
significance: Created the state holding that NeutraDC (Telkom) later called its 'ecosystem' when securing land and PLN power for data centres.

title: US rescinds AI Diffusion Rule
description: BIS said it would not enforce the Diffusion Rule, removing Indonesia's Tier 2 cap, while adding guidance on Huawei Ascend chips and diversion.
significance: Left Indonesia licence-free for advanced chips, but under diversion scrutiny.

title: Oracle opens Batam cloud region
description: Oracle launched its Indonesia North region in Batam (ap-batam-1) with one availability domain; reports said it leases DayOne's Nongsa Digital Park halls.
significance: First hyperscale cloud region placed in Batam rather than Jakarta, validating the Singapore-overflow pitch.

title: Microsoft Indonesia Central region goes live
description: Microsoft's three-zone Indonesia Central cloud region in Jakarta became available to customers.
significance: Indonesia became one of few Southeast Asian markets hosting all three US hyperscalers and three Chinese clouds.

title: DBS and UOB lend IDR 6.7tn for DayOne-INA Batam campus
description: Singapore's DBS and UOB arranged about US$411m for three DayOne data centres (about 72MW) at Nongsa Digital Park, co-developed with sovereign fund INA.
actor: DayOne; Indonesia Investment Authority; DBS; UOB
significance: INA's first data centre deal tied the state to Batam's Singapore-overflow model, built by a GDS spin-off.

title: Singapore and Indonesia sign cross-border electricity MoUs
description: The two governments signed three MoUs in Jakarta, including one to set policies and commercial terms for cross-border electricity trade within a year, plus CCS cooperation.
significance: Tied Indonesian clean power exports to wider economic deals as Batam's own data centre load grew.

title: Edgnex (DAMAC) starts US$2.3bn Jakarta AI campus
description: Dubai's Edgnex began building a 144MW AI-focused campus in Greater Jakarta, phase 1 due December 2026.
significance: Gulf capital entered at hyperscale size.

title: Komdigi, Indosat, Nvidia and Cisco launch AI Center of Excellence
description: Indonesia launched a Komdigi-led AI Center of Excellence with an Nvidia Blackwell AI factory run by Indosat and a Cisco security cloud, part of sovereign AI plans.
significance: Put sovereign AI on US hardware, a contrast to the Chinese cloud footprint.

title: US-Indonesia trade framework includes data transfer clause
description: A joint framework cut the threatened US tariff from 32% to 19%; Indonesia agreed to allow personal data transfers to the US by recognising US protection as adequate.
actor: Governments of the US and Indonesia
significance: Weakened the localisation case for US clouds and drew data sovereignty criticism at home.

title: Draft AI roadmap proposes Danantara-run sovereign AI fund
description: A draft national AI roadmap seen by Reuters proposed a sovereign AI fund, mainly managed by Danantara, to be set up in 2027 to 2029 via public-private partnership.
significance: Signalled state money for AI compute, though still a draft.

title: WSJ: Chinese AI startup uses Blackwell GPUs via Indosat
description: Reports said Shanghai's INF Tech rented compute from 32 Nvidia GB200 racks (about 2,300 GPUs, about US$100m) installed at Indosat in Jakarta, sold by US server maker Aivres; lawyers said it appeared legal.
significance: Showed Indonesian data centres as a channel for Chinese access to top US chips (reported, no wrongdoing found).

title: Energy ministry projects 5.2GW of data centre demand by 2034
description: An energy ministry adviser said data centre power demand was about 1.1GW in 2025 and could reach 5.2GW by 2034, served by PLN, PLN Batam and regional utilities.
actor: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM)
significance: First official demand curve; far below PLN's later 25GW inquiry tally.

title: Bloomberg flags Megaspeed, with Indonesian footprint
description: Bloomberg reported US concern that Singapore's Megaspeed, Nvidia's largest Southeast Asian buyer, may be a conduit to China; summaries say it cited Indonesian and Malaysian customs records and that Megaspeed claims data centres in both. Nvidia said it found no evidence of diversion.
significance: Allegation only: put Indonesian sites inside the chip-smuggling debate.
source_name: TechFlow via KuCoin (summarising Bloomberg and NYT)

title: Digital Edge commits US$4.5bn to 500MW Bekasi campus
description: Digital Edge announced a 500MW IT campus at GIIC, Bekasi, scalable to 1GW, with three buildings due Q4 2026 to Q2 2027.
significance: Largest single campus pledge in Indonesia, cementing the Cikarang-GIIC belt.

title: US finalises reciprocal trade deal with Indonesia
description: The White House said the US keeps a 19% tariff with 0% for some goods; Indonesia backs a permanent WTO moratorium on e-transmission duties and cooperation on export controls.
actor: Governments of the US and Indonesia
significance: Locked in the tariff truce and added export-control cooperation that touches AI chips.

title: Industry warns water is data centres' next constraint
description: IDPRO's chairman said hyperscale sites can use 1 to 5 million litres a day with evaporative cooling, and that water will be the second strategic issue after energy in Jakarta and Batam.
significance: Early warning before Batam's protests.

title: DayOne signs 450MW power deal with PLN Batam
description: DayOne signed a 511MVA (about 450MW) PPA with PLN Batam for its Kabil campus, phased over 2026 and 2027, billed as Indonesia's largest long-term PPA.
significance: Showed Batam's separate utility could deliver hyperscale power fast, a draw versus Java's grid.

title: China's RangeIDC backs US$5bn Batam AI data centre
description: Shenzhen-listed RangeIDC, via local developer Equator Gate System Batam, plans a US$5bn AI data centre on 30ha in Nongsa, with a power agreement with PLN Batam signed in late May.
actor: RangeIDC; PT Equator Gate System Batam; PLN Batam
significance: Largest openly Chinese-backed data centre pledge in Indonesia, landing days before the US parent-company chip rule.

title: BIS reaffirms licences for China-parented buyers anywhere
description: BIS guidance confirmed that since November 2023 advanced AI chips sent to companies headquartered in China, or with their ultimate parent there, need a US licence wherever they operate; existing chips need not be removed.
significance: Covers Chinese-owned operators and tenants in Indonesia (article names Malaysia, not Indonesia).

title: Firmus and Nvidia plan 360MW AI factory in Batam
description: Australia's Firmus, with Nvidia and builder DayOne, unveiled a 360MW Nvidia AI factory in Batam from Q1 2027, with US$25bn to 30bn of contracted purchases expected over six years.
significance: Biggest Nvidia-linked AI project in Indonesia, sited in Batam rather than Java.

title: NeutraDC and PLN sign 200MW Cikarang power MoU
description: Telkom's NeutraDC signed an MoU with PLN to secure phased power for up to 200MW of hyperscale capacity in Cikarang.
significance: State-to-state deal inside the Danantara group to fix power timing on Java.

title: PLN tallies 25GW of data centre power interest by 2034
description: PLN said data centre demand could reach about 25GW by 2034; Indonesia had about 580MW of installed IT capacity and PLN served 159 data centre customers (about 1,990MVA), 99% on Java-Madura-Bali.
significance: Requests far outrun the ministry's 5.2GW forecast and the grid's build rate.

title: Batam residents protest data centres amid water cuts
description: Hundreds stormed the Nongsa SEZ office as household taps ran dry while data centres, fed from Duriangkang reservoir, kept water; BP Batam counts 16 hyperscale projects.
actor: Nongsa residents; BP Batam; Nongsa Digital Park
significance: First social backlash against Batam's data centre model; the park denies responsibility.

title: Residents blockade Nongsa Digital Park
description: Nongsa residents blocked access to the park; BP Batam promised piped water within two days and sent tankers, with supply restored to about 53% of affected areas by mid-week.
significance: Protests escalated from offices to the park gate; no moratorium announced.
